thread:
maria: Quick sprint: need hero copy + CTAs for Hosted / Dedicated / Private, two launch post blurbs, webinar landing copy, and inbound routing. Drafts by Monday please.

jake: Got it. Who are we targeting per mode?

sunita: Hosted = PLG devs; Dedicated = infra/platform teams; Private = security/compliance stakeholders. Tone guidance: Hosted = energetic & practical; Dedicated = dependable & technical; Private = formal & controls-first.

lia: Design plan: three hero directions (product screenshot, throughput visual, compliance badges) + two CTA variants (Get started / Book demo).

jake: Draft hero lines: Hosted: `Production-grade LLM API 1 minutes to your first token.` Dedicated: `Reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput and SLAs.` Private: `Run inference in your VPC with enterprise controls and audit logs.` Will do CTAs per mode.

oliver: Launch posts: 1) Benchmarks (headline numbers + PDF download), 2) Ops story (customer moved to prod using routing/fallback). Webinar = deep dive + live Q&A. Posts should gate the benchmark PDF and drive signups.

sunita: I'll prepare a short methodology appendix for the benchmark post: hardware, sequence lengths, batching, quantization, routing variants. Need infra to confirm kernel/compat settings.

maria: Inbound routing: Hosted leads -> product onboarding flow; Dedicated -> SDR queue; Private -> AE + security intake. Add hidden form field `mode_interest` and UTMs on all forms. Example: `<input type="hidden" name="mode_interest" value="private">`.

jake: I'll include hero copy, 2 post blurbs (benchmarks + ops), webinar landing headline & bullets, and email subject A/B lines by Mon EOD. Suggested email A/B: A) `New benchmarks: lower cost, same latency` B) `How teams ship production LLM features`.

lia: I'll deliver hero comps Tue morning and export social image sizes.

oliver: Growth will wire the registration page with a short segment radio (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) and the hidden `mode_interest` field; recommend a checkbox for `interested in dedicated pricing`.

maria: Timeline confirmed. Owners: Jake (copy), Sunita (benchmarks), Lia (design), Oliver (webinar funnel). I'll collate assets in #marketing-assets and schedule publish.

growth-bot: Webinar created: "Serving Modes Showcase" Tue, invites sent.

maria: Thanks team 1 updating the brief now. :rocket:
